settings.custom_description: We’d love to hear from you! Whether you have a question, need assistance, or simply want to share your feedback, our team is ready to help. Feel free to reach out to us using the form below, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

settings.text:
If you have any questions about returns, exchanges or any other questions, comments, or concerns,
please contact us at support@blueteesgolf.com. The Blue Tees Golf® Customer Support team answers
emails within 24 hours Monday through Friday.

If you purchased a Blue Tees product and need assistance, contact support@blueteesgolf.com

If you're a retail partner and need assistance with a product you've sold, contact
sales-support@blueteesgolf.com
Please check your spam or junk folders. All responses for your support case will be emailed from support@blueteesgolf.com
